description: React TSX (jest + RTL): the empty-cart branch of CheckoutButton is untested.
pr_body:
Add a CheckoutButton to the cart page.

## Acceptance criteria
- The button is enabled when the cart has items.
- The button is disabled and labelled "Cart is empty" when the cart is empty.

expected.notes: missing_test on the empty-cart branch. The enabled state and the click handler are tested.
